security_page.hero_title: How AirDrop P2P End-to-End Encryption Works
security_page.hero_subtitle: Your files are transferred directly device-to-device (Browser-to-Browser). No servers, cloud storages, or third parties ever access your data.
security_page.pillar1_desc: All data is encrypted directly in your browser using DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security). Neither ISPs nor website owners can read your data stream.
security_page.pillar2_desc: Files are never uploaded to any intermediate servers. They are chunked in RAM and assembled directly in receiver's RAM via WebRTC.
security_page.pillar3_desc: Transfer files of any size — 1 GB, 10 GB, 50 GB and more! You are not restricted by messenger limits (Telegram 2 GB, email 25 MB) or cloud limits.
security_page.pillar4_desc: No registration, emails, phone numbers, or passwords required. Once room session ends, temporary signal metadata is destroyed forever.
security_page.cta_subtitle: Generate a PIN code and send it to the receiver in 1 click
